column1: # H168a (Opus vision subagent, 28 Sept 2026, one call; prompt verbatim in scripts/PROMPTS.md H168a; tools used: Read, Read, SubagentHandback). Reply verbatim.

VERDICT: Page A's only long plain stretch (a list of conference delegates, "Messieurs l'Archevesque de Lyon, l'Evesque d'Avranches, l'Abbé de St Vincent de Laon, Montolin, le Baron de Talmay ... et de ma part les Srs de Villars, de Villeroy ... Jeannin ... conference ... Suresne ... Monsieur le Legat ... a l'ouverture de cette conference") does not appear on page B. Page B reads as continuous prose about the zeal for religion, the preservation of the crown, the people and a "conclusion", with none of A's names, so on the evidence of these two pages it is a different letter, or at least not page A written out in full. Readings are provisional: the hand is small and the image is reduced. Short sign-groups inside the cipher lines that look like letters (e.g. "gab", "nob") were treated as cipher.
